description: Finds the soonest time a rental car in North Cyprus is free for a given number of days. Requires duration_days. Without an earliest pickup the search starts from now, and the result gives that start as searched_from.

category.description: Optional car class. Omit for every class.

currency.description: Also price in this currency (*_quoted amounts).

duration_days.description: Rental length in whole days. Ask if not stated.

earliest_pickup_at.description: Earliest pickup 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm' the person named, Cyprus local time. Omit to search from now.

language.description: Language of the result and the booking link: 'tr' for Turkish, otherwise 'en'.

name: next_available
title: Find the soonest free rental
